cat >> specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md <<'EOF'

## WebSocket access (#144)

### Wire validation

- "'`list_conversations` is accepted independently of configuration, discards a frame'"'s "'`userId`, and accepts an optional integer `limit` from 1 through 200 and an optional `before: {updatedAt, sessionId}` cursor; incomplete cursors, non-string or unparseable dates, non-string session ids and invalid limits are rejected with a field-naming validation error ([validated by: validates history limits and complete ISO cursors independently of configuration](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L1)).

### Wire history

- With `transport.history.enabled`, a request returns exactly one `conversation_list` containing only the connection'"'s authenticated user's metadata, including its current conversation, newest first with ISO times and no content or credentials; the store receives that user's id and "'`{limit, before}`, tied rows page without loss, and a listed id reconnects through the existing ownership-checked resume and replay path ([validated by: lists only the authenticated users metadata, pages ties and resumes a listed conversation](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L1)).

### Wire opt-in

- History is a separate, default-off disclosure decision: absent or disabled history, a store without `listFor`, and a Mongo collection without `find` return one `UNSUPPORTED` error rather than an empty list, without closing the socket ([validated by: answers UNSUPPORTED when history is absent, disabled or the store cannot list](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L1)).

### Wire failure

- A store failure returns one sanitized `SERVER_ERROR`, leaves the socket open and logs the session id without store details or user content ([validated by: reports a real store failure without leaking details or closing the socket](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L1)).

### Wire lock

- A requested history response bypasses the per-session turn lock and arrives before a pending turn ends ([validated by: answers history while a real turn holds the session lock](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L1)).
EOF
cat >> specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md <<'"'EOF'

## 14. Conversation list (#144)

"'`list_conversations` requests metadata over the authenticated connection. Its validation is static, including when history is disabled ([validated by: validates history limits and complete ISO cursors independently of configuration](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L1)).

| Client field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | string | Yes | `list_conversations` |
| `limit` | integer | No | 1–200 |
| `before` | object | No | `{updatedAt, sessionId}` from the last row; both strings, with a parseable ISO time |

The response is one `conversation_list`, with no `stream_end`; it carries only the authenticated user'"'s conversation metadata, never content or credentials, and the user id comes from the connection, never the frame ([validated by: lists only the authenticated users metadata, pages ties and resumes a listed conversation](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L1)).

| Server field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| "'`type` | string | `conversation_list` |
| `conversations` | array | Rows containing only `sessionId`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, `entryCount`; both times are ISO strings |

`transport.history` is the deployer'"'s separate decision to expose personal history to the client; it defaults off, and unavailable history returns "'`UNSUPPORTED` rather than claiming there are no conversations ([validated by: answers UNSUPPORTED when history is absent, disabled or the store cannot list](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L1)).

Store failures produce a sanitized `SERVER_ERROR` without disconnecting the client ([validated by: reports a real store failure without leaking details or closing the socket](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L1)).

History requests bypass the turn lock ([validated by: answers history while a real turn holds the session lock](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L1)).
EOF
cat > .lore/dod.md <<'"'EOF'
# Definition of Done

> It does not give a **client** anything: the browser holding the socket cannot reach the store, so
> every consumer that wants a history sidebar has to stand up its own authenticated HTTP route over
> the same data the engine already authenticated on the upgrade.

**Strategy: "'`direct`** — The pure validator and `createHalEngine` expose the real entry points. Real sockets, real in-memory and Mongo store operations, a recording subclass that delegates every list, and a lifecycle hook holding a real turn exercise the boundary without replacing production behavior.

## Done when these pass

- [ ] **validates history limits and complete ISO cursors independently of configuration** — Accept the new frame and reject malformed fields by name.
  `src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`
- [ ] **lists only the authenticated users metadata, pages ties and resumes a listed conversation** — Thread the config, use the authenticated id (including the recorded store argument), serialize only metadata, forward paging and reuse resume.
  `src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`
- [ ] **answers UNSUPPORTED when history is absent, disabled or the store cannot list** — Distinguish unavailable history from an empty history, including a collection without find.
  `src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`
- [ ] **reports a real store failure without leaking details or closing the socket** — Sanitize a genuine Mongo adapter failure and retain a usable socket.
  `src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`
- [ ] **answers history while a real turn holds the session lock** — Answer before the pending turn ends; no external model request is needed.
  `src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`

## Facets

- [ ] Add the four public protocol interfaces and union members, keeping old message literals valid and ConnectedMessage unchanged; add static cursor and limit validation.
- [ ] Thread the independently default-off history option through the factory and server; warn when history is enabled without resume and mirror the retention note pointing at #41.
- [ ] Dispatch outside the turn lock using ws.userId, return only ISO metadata when asked, and forward both paging options unchanged.
- [ ] Export StoreCannotList and map unavailable capability to UNSUPPORTED; map other failures to sanitized SERVER_ERROR and log the session id without user content.
- [ ] Preserve reconnect/replay and document opening a listed id with resume enabled.
- [ ] Update example/full-config.ts and regenerate getting-started with docs:fix; add the consumer changelog and MINOR version bump, and preserve the new spec citations.

## Out of scope

- Titles, previews, client erasure, an operator view, server-held paging state, live synchronization and a second replay path.
- Unrelated unlinked statements in the broad WebSocket protocol specification; the conversation-list store contract already has citations throughout.
- Source-text assertions about additive diffs or documentation; those are reviewed as implementation facets, with CI checking compilation and generated docs.
- The existing Lore list adapter emits only id/name/file, not spec descriptors. Test comments stamp their spec anchors and statements link directly to the executable tests; changing that adapter is separate tooling work.
EOF
